author: Ludwisarz
quote: It is not a GTA game anymore. Why am I discouraged from killing people? The whole point of GTA games, and what made them so famous, is that you could kill anyone, have no consequences, and have fun. And now I can't kill activists, and I can't kill people in gay clubs. Why are you making them protected? It is a video game; you should be able to kill anyone you want. No people get hurt in real life if you commit crimes in a video game. It used to be a game about committing crimes, goddamnit. Why are you trying to teach me morals? Why are you trying to make this game a lesson? The only function **** is to be fun. I don't want to be taught your morals. Why are you trying to force your worldview upon me via a video game? And why have you added boring chores to a **** GTA game? If I wanted to do chores, I would turn off the PS5. There was a mission about building a house in RDR2, but it made more sense because you were already invested in the story of Abigail and John at the end of the second game. You are not invested here. Why are you making me buy groceries and flowers for an in-game girlfriend that is boring AF? And they removed prostitutes. Why won't you let people have sex with a prostitute, kill her, and steal your money back? This is GTA. This is what made your series so popular—the consequence-free chaos where you could do whatever you want. They literally made it a game for girls. They simply **** out and prevented people from doing anything controversial. They got scared after people were killing that feminist in RDR2 because she was annoying AF. They wanted it to be a game for everyone, so they castrated it. I just want a game where you are a badass criminal having fun, not playing a boring, soulless girlfriend simulator.

quote: The game is perfectly fine. Since stealth games are dying out it's good to see a new game in this genre. I feel like most of the negative reviews are mainly because it's become fashionable to criticize ubisoft.

author: Ludwisarz
quote: I am putting it on the podium as my #1 favorite game of all time, along with rdr2. Yes, it's that good.

author: Ludwisarz
quote: People complain that this game is different from the previous one. If you want to keep playing the same game, you might as well keep playing the first Frostpunk. This game is for those who had fun in the previous one but are now looking for something fresh and new. There's so much complaining about games now that just added 2 to their name and hope for money. This game boldly expanded its mechanics and scale, and in my humble opinion it turned out amazing. You just have to set your mind that you are playing a different game now.
